features.title: Inline subtask composer keys: Enter adds, empty Enter or Escape or blur dismisses, and keys do not reach global handlers
features.trigger: A row's inline subtask composer is open (opened via the row menu's Add subtask), and the user types in its input, presses Enter or Escape, or moves focus away.
features.context: The composer is a TextInput rendered under the row with placeholder 'Subtask title — Enter to add'. Its onKeyDown calls e.stopPropagation() first, so keystrokes never reach the window-level useAppKeyboard map. Enter with a non-empty trimmed value calls onSubmit(title) and clears the field, so the composer stays open for the next subtask. Enter with an empty value calls onDismiss(). Escape calls onDismiss(). onBlur also calls onDismiss(). The index only has F09-050 (one composer open at a time), which does not cover these keys.
features.result: Enter with text submits a subtask and keeps the composer open with an empty field. Enter on an empty field, Escape, or losing focus closes the composer without creating anything. Global shortcuts such as Escape-clears-selection or Delete do not fire while the composer has focus.
